title: Trump Signs Executive Orders Targeting Birthright Citizenship and ‘Birth Tourism’
summary: The orders come after the Supreme Court ruled June 30 that President Trump’s previous efforts to end birthright citizenship were unconstitutional.

title: Trump Administration to Deregulate Head Start, Antipoverty Program Created Under R.F.K. Jr.’s Uncle
summary: While administration officials say the changes will save money by lifting onerous requirements, advocates fear the anti-poverty program will be gutted.

title: Meta Ordered to Pay $567 Million Fine by New Mexico Judge
summary: The penalty, imposed by a state judge, is on top of a $375 million fine ordered by a jury that found Meta misled users about the safety of its platforms.

title: In Upset, Andy Ogles Loses to a Republican Challenger in Tennessee
summary: Mr. Ogles, a two-term congressman, had held off primary threats before, despite controversy. But on Thursday, Charlie Hatcher, a former state agriculture commissioner, delivered an upset.

title: Blackburn Wins Republican Nomination for Tennessee Governor
summary: Senator Marsha Blackburn easily beat two Republican rivals and is now favored to become the state’s first female governor after the November elections.

title: Mitch McConnell Discharged From Rehabilitation Facility
summary: The Kentucky Republican has been absent from Congress for nearly two months after a health episode. He said he would continue recovering from home.

title: Some House Republicans Are Backing a Challenger in Cory Mills’s Re-election Bid
summary: Two Republican lawmakers have endorsed a primary opponent of Representative Cory Mills, who has been accused of assault and is under investigation by the House Ethics Committee.

title: After Trump Calls Canadians ‘Nasty,’ Mark Carney Says the Word Fits Trade Talks
summary: Canada’s prime minister laughed off Trump’s description of Canada but suggested that trade talks between the two countries are acrimonious.

title: Trump Issues Tariffs on Key Ingredient for Electronics and Solar Panels
summary: The administration will impose a minimum import price for polysilicon, a key component for semiconductors and solar panels, as well as tariffs for products made with the material.

title: This A.I. Just Created Viruses Not Found in Nature
summary: Scientists trained artificial intelligence on libraries of DNA and then asked the model to create recipes for viral genomes. Sixteen of them were viable, yielding new viruses.

title: Senate Panel Votes to Hold Fauci in Contempt of Congress
summary: Dr. Anthony Fauci had refused to answer questions at a hearing last week, invoking the Fifth Amendment. Republicans argued he wasn’t entitled to that protection because he had a presidential pardon.

title: Fauci Is Far From the First Person to Plead the Fifth Before Congress
summary: The constitutional right against self-incrimination has been invoked on several occasions during high-profile — and contentious — hearings.

title: Sydney Towle, Who Chronicled Her Cancer on TikTok, Dies at 26
summary: For an audience that grew to more than a million followers, she challenged assumptions about how people with serious illnesses should look and live.

title: ‘I Have Cancer,’ the TikTok Star Said. Then Came the Torrent of Hate.
summary: Sydney Towle’s videos have drawn an enormous audience on TikTok, where her followers praise and support her. On Reddit, an army of skeptics was determined to paint her as a fraud.

title: Fled to America at 11. Stole at 18. Deported to Vietnam at 44.
summary: The Trump administration is sending back record numbers of Vietnamese, Laotians and Hmong. Many came to the United States as young war refugees and later committed crimes.

title: Voter-Registration Error Could Cost Immigrants a Shot at a Green Card
summary: New Jersey improperly added as many as 6,600 noncitizens to its voter rolls. Those people could now be forced out of the country.

title: How Japan Minimized Deaths from a Major Earthquake
summary: After deadly tremors a decade ago, Kumamoto built earthquake-resistant buildings and even trained locals in search and rescue.

title: Alcohol. Manliness. Flushable Wipes. Since When Are These ‘Scams’?
summary: Americans have been taken with scams for years. Now, the word is being used for any system that ends with somebody profiting at their expense.

title: At the Fed, Kevin Warsh Can’t Referee His Way Out of Inflation
summary: The success of his chairmanship may rest on an issue that sits outside the traditional purview of monetary policy: the nation’s ongoing fiscal deficits.

title: The Real Reason Behind Trump’s Yen Intervention
summary: The U.S. is bolstering the yen, as it did with the Argentine peso. The reasons are not solely economic.

title: Thailand School Shooting Leaves at Least Six
summary: A student opened fire at a high school near Bangkok, according to local news media.
